storm-surge.def: A rise in sea level pushed onto the coast by a storm's winds and low pressure. Mangroves, marshes and barrier islands reduce its height and force before it reaches homes.

wetland-drainage.def: Removing water from a wetland with ditches, pipes or fill so the land can be farmed or built on. It destroys wetland habitat and the services wetlands provide, such as flood storage and water filtering.
